title: Escaped newlines break arguments in version 9
contractNotes: Template line continuations must not lose argument characters; verify whitespace, joined words, repeated continuations, interpolation and ordinary compatibility. Cases independently authored from issue plus public template API.

title: Fix using both `stdin: 'inherit'` and `input` options
publicBody:
See #1218.

When using any of the following options:
  - `{input: 'foo', stdio: 'inherit'}`   
  - `{input: 'foo', stdio: ['inherit', ...]}`
  - `{input: 'foo', stdin: 'inherit'}`

Execa should silently use the following instead: `{input: 'foo', stdin: 'pipe', ...}`.

Please note that if users need multiple inputs, they can still use the `{stdin: ['inherit', {string: 'foo'}]` option.

This is technically a breaking change, so should be in a major release.
contractNotes: Explicit input takes precedence over a lone inherited stdin across async/sync and stdin/stdio spellings. Compare two payloads against deliberately different inherited stdin. No external commands or network. Public issue explicitly requests semantic change for major release.

title: Default value for priority doesn't get applied
contractNotes: Undefined priority defaults to zero; equal priorities preserve insertion order, explicit priorities sort descending, sizeBy zero sees default-priority items. Native selection tests existing priority cases.
